ai_summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited successfully conducted its 47th Annual General Meeting virtually, during which shareholders adopted the unqualified FY2026 standalone and consolidated financial statements. A dividend of Rs. 0.70 per share was declared, and the re-appointment of key whole-time directors and ratification of cost auditor remuneration were approved. The proceedings indicate adherence to corporate governance with no identified red flags, specifically noting clean reports from both Statutory and Secretarial Auditors.
